sources.title: ISO 1832:2017 - Indexable inserts for cutting tools - Designation
Kennametal TopSwiss Turning Inserts Application Data

tool_updates.description: Kennametal TopSwiss CCET positive right-hand insert, ANSI CCET2150RPPS / ISO CCET060200RPPS, tolerance class E, 6.35 mm IC, 2.38 mm thickness, 2.8 mm fixing hole, and nominally sharp 0.00 mm corner. PPS parallel-positive geometry for low-to-medium-feed machining. KN10S is an uncoated, fine-grain carbide grade primarily for non-ferrous materials.

material_recommendations.notes: Reviewed catalog profile: Wrought Aluminum Alloys.

tool_updates.description: Kennametal TopSwiss CCGT positive FFS fine-finishing insert, ANSI CCGT3251MFFS / ISO CCGT09T304MFFS, 9.53 mm IC, 3.97 mm thickness, 4.4 mm fixing hole, and nominal 0.4 mm corner radius. Curved, polished, and lapped geometry for precision finish machining at low depths of cut. KCS25S is a coated carbide grade primarily intended for high-temperature alloys and available as an alternate for stainless steel.
